findings.location: ReadProvisionerResultAsync, lines 1359-1400; contrasted with data-model.md lines 523-537 and release-verification-contract.md lines 288-315
findings.affected_requirement: FR-018, SC-007, T068, T070, T072, and the closed ProvisionerResult contract
findings.evidence: The host reads result.json with JsonDocument and checks only selected values. It does not reject unknown or duplicate fields, does not bind runNonceHash to the current run nonce, does not verify contentHash, and does not validate the CodeGraph requirements-lock hash or the complete declared result field set. ValidateSanitizedProvisionerResult only scans forbidden substrings. The accepted contract explicitly requires whole-result rejection for unknown/duplicate fields, wrong nonce/schema, and invalid closed output. Existing candidate tests describe the result property names but contain no negative host-parser cases for these conditions.
findings.correction_outcome: Add a closed typed host-side result validator that detects duplicate and unknown fields, validates every required field and format, binds the nonce hash to the active run, recomputes the defined content hash, verifies the CodeGraph lock identity, and rejects incomplete/non-atomic output before product state or release evidence is accepted. Add observed RED then GREEN negative tests for each rejected variant.

findings.evidence: The live command mounts three files from a pre-existing bin/Release publish directory by filename only. No live pre-acquisition step hashes those bytes, proves they were freshly published from candidate 981a96ed7f332d4917fcfc4c286e6b078a6c8106, or compares their names against the inspected image /app inventory. The publish test validates only filenames in a separate disposable output directory. The release evidence model also omits the required candidate-bound driver inventory, fixed mount identities, and sanitized provisioner-result hash, so stale or replaced driver bytes can execute beside an honestly labeled image and T073 cannot validate the required attestation from the evidence bundle.
findings.correction_outcome: Before any live acquisition, publish or independently bind the exact three driver files to the reviewed candidate, hash and inventory them, compare their names against the inspected /app inventory, reject stale/colliding/unexpected bytes, and record only sanitized driver hashes, mount identities, provisioner-result hash, same-image facts, and resource cleanup identities/outcomes in release evidence. Add RED/GREEN tests that replace a driver, add a collision, omit an attestation, and prove the live plan fails before provisioner creation.

summary: REVISE. The combined expedited acceptance-and-quality review pinned base 0b83ef16a052999b39c5122ffc0e2cfb91d3035b, candidate 981a96ed7f332d4917fcfc4c286e6b078a6c8106, tree e9f29608eb0a9ac28ecccb8bde2c4c2c713c68d6, exact binary diff SHA-256 3c982ce4a7641dc87aa0cc14091e146e3cd7e2c64996912007f51f21306c20bf, and canonical production-source-manifest-v1 SHA-256 e2b806c62932d710fea88d02710a020a06594aa3f49bb7b312ae7057bb3d22ea. Raw review confirmed one Dockerfile build command and immutable sha256 binding for provisioner/app, exactly three read-only driver mounts, image-owned product assemblies and hash-locked CodeGraphContext checks, no host cgc/Python/pip fallback, no second candidate image, no migration/model/package/Dockerfile change, no fixture SQL/direct DbSet/reflection/fabricated identity, no retry/general Scan expansion, and the unchanged seven-slot Pass 2 surface. Candidate evidence records Option A 4/4, Pass 1/Pass 2 29/29, currentness 3/3, non-live release harness 44/44, quickstart 137/137, migration 10/10, both no-pending-model checks, Release builds, exact three-file publish, static checks, and no live resource acquisition. This reviewer began the combined non-live release/currentness/Pass1/Pass2 filter, but it reached the 184-second command timeout without result output; no Docker, PostgreSQL, provider, Repository, CodeGraph, browser, network, or Playwright resource was activated. The unchanged ExactResolutionProfile b842-versus-3a71 line-ending assertion remains a pre-existing baseline limitation and was not caused by this candidate. T072 is not accepted-safe because two unresolved High findings leave the provisioner trust and evidence boundary incomplete; pending T072/T073 live evidence is not itself a defect.
